note: Both sets capture the core facts (window azimuth 0, truncated isosceles triangle louver shape, 25-degree bend, the depth-to-height algorithm, and the 1:1 ratio) and both include a vague claim where 'solar altitude' is used as the entity rather than a component. Set A additionally binds the 50-degree solar altitude correctly to the Harvest Shade Screen with the fall equinox at 12pm condition, which Set B omits. Set B instead duplicates the bend claim with a misread condition ('along the louver longitude' instead of the longitudinal section), giving it one more defect than A.
